# luci-app-netbird

> A LuCI web interface for managing the NetBird mesh-VPN client (WireGuard-based) on OpenWrt and ImmortalWrt routers: log in with a setup key, connect to NetBird cloud or a self-hosted management server, change every `netbird up` option, pick an exit node, manage the NetBird binary, and set up the router's firewall zone — without the command line. Free and open source (Apache-2.0).

## Facts

- Supported firmware: OpenWrt / ImmortalWrt 22.03, 23.05 and 24.10 (opkg, `.ipk` packages) and 25.12 and current snapshots (apk, `.apk` packages). 21.02 and older are not supported because they lack ucode.
- The LuCI package is architecture-independent. The NetBird client comes from the firmware's package feed or from official NetBird releases (amd64, arm64, 386, armv6); other architectures use the package-feed build.
- Works with NetBird cloud and self-hosted NetBird servers (set the Management URL before connecting).
- Exit node selection is persisted and restored after a reboot.
- Automatic reconnect keeps the router connected after network outages.
- Packages are signed; the feed is served from https://luci-app-netbird.okk.sh/.

## Install

- English UI: `sh -c "$(curl -fsSL https://luci-app-netbird.okk.sh/install.sh)"` or `wget -O - https://luci-app-netbird.okk.sh/install.sh | sh`
- With the Simplified Chinese language pack: `wget -O - https://luci-app-netbird.okk.sh/install-zh.sh | sh`
- After installing, open LuCI → Services → NetBird.
